growth_signal.value: Says it already handles more than a million guest interactions a month across hundreds of hotel properties.

entry.idea: Hotels and other hospitality businesses juggle many manual jobs like reservations, guest requests, and staffing, so Dextr AI builds AI agents that handle these tasks for them automatically.
entry.lesson: Build AI agents that are narrowly focused on one industry's daily grunt work, rather than a general-purpose assistant.
entry.name: Dextr AI

growth.reason: Serving hundreds of properties and over a million interactions a month is a real number, but there is no data yet on how fast that is growing.

market.reason: Hospitality is a large, worldwide industry that every hotel and resort could use this for.

tech.reason: Building AI agents for hotel workflows is solid engineering, but well-resourced rivals could copy it within a year or two.

entry.twist: Instead of one general AI assistant, Dextr AI makes agents dedicated to hospitality's own repetitive jobs, and already runs more than a million guest interactions a month for hundreds of hotels.
entry.who_pays: Hotels and other hospitality businesses pay to use Dextr AI's platform to run their operations.
entry.why_now: AI systems have become capable enough to run whole workflows like reservations and guest service on their own, just as hotels struggle to find and keep enough staff.
